checkpoint_finding.declared_base_reason: The whole-human checkpoint was released in 2023 from the declared CELLxGENE Census 2023-05-08 normal-human corpus, before GSE281160 became public.
checkpoint_finding.future_project_fit_rule: A generator trained on GSE281160 is continual_seen for that dataset and cannot be described as zero-shot or external; record exact rows, controls, target genes, vocabulary, preprocessing, split, initialized parameters, seeds, and artifact hashes.

preprocessing_and_evaluation_incidents.finding: The official tutorial uses an upstream GEARS simulation split rather than project grouping by target locus, guide family, and biological replicate.
GEARS-derived global controls and DE metadata can cross outer roles unless the project split precedes every preprocessing object.
Training randomly caps features at 1536 and can omit the perturbed gene; the project requires forced target retention.
Only base encoder components are initialized, while the perturbation embedding and decoder are new and the tutorial optimizes the entire generator.
Noncoding loci and guide pseudo-genes are not valid measured whole-human vocabulary tokens; OOV-to-pad is not a target representation.

prediction_first_rule.gse313774: The single-cell gene-perturbation generator cannot directly query bulk condition/insulin arms. No post-outcome remapping into a stress prediction is allowed; CXCL1 and IL8 remain excluded.

remaining_blockers: Do not schedule the scGPT perturbation head for GSE281160 unless a new in-vocabulary gene-perturbation task is registered.
Resolve and hash the exact whole-human weight bytes and base-weight terms.
Freeze the exact cell-gears and full runtime lock and patch deprecated NumPy API use in a new immutable adapter revision.
Resolve GSE281160 biological replicates, custom reference, guide-to-locus table, matrix layer, gene vocabulary, and output scale.
Implement split-first preprocessing, fold-local controls, strict OOV rejection, forced target retention, deterministic feature selection, and safe state-dict loading.
Freeze trained perturbation artifacts and pass isolated GPU, resume, numeric, and leakage fixtures.

systema_audit.rule: The independent evaluator computes O_pert only from training perturbation-specific replicate centroids; residualization cannot turn an OOV noncoding target into a valid gene token.
